b: Leila Latif and David Jenkins celebrate the releases of Martin McDonagh's Wild Horse Nine, out in UK cinemas from 6 November, and is also the cover film for issue 115 of LWLies print edition, the link to which can be found below. The pair also discuss Lee Chang-dong's epic Possible Love, which streams on Netflix from 6 November.
